sentence: On the archival side, innovation gains from AI are amplified where executives hold IT backgrounds
passage: [Feng et al. (2025), p. 1] "Further analysis shows that AI-driven innovation is amplified in firms with executives who have information technology backgrounds, and that highly innovative firms diversify their supply chain to reduce resource risk."

gemini.note: The passage explicitly states the finding that AI-driven innovation is amplified in firms where executives have IT backgrounds, which fully supports the sentence.
